status: unapproved author fact checks, not independent verification

checks.finding: Older and modern dictionary entries identify uncle/nephew family roles and eyelid, cheek, eyebrow and nostril anatomy. Nepot has two everyday family senses; both are male relatives. No exact-two-eyelids claim.

Original recipe authors document familiar stuffed peppers, filled eggs, jam-filled doughnuts and sweet/savory filled crepes. The group refers to prepared variants, not an assertion that every serving is stuffed.

Manufacturer guitar and bicycle catalogs, operator documentation and Bosch appliance documentation substantiate real electric variants of all four concepts. This does not call every train, oven, guitar or bicycle electric.

Original dictionary definitions across old/new editions establish the movable closure of an entrance. Current manufacturer interior-door catalog independently corroborates ordinary household usage; no product recommendation, price or regulation is imported.

Jamila original chocolate ice cream combines cocoa and milk. Laura Laurentiu original marble cake recipe (2009) uses cocoa/milk and its later economic cake description explicitly recommends serving cake with milk. This directly supports the native served_together second edge, without silently recasting it as an ingredient edge. Current Savori Urbane original video provides an independent cocoa/milk ice cream example.

method: Live source pages and search-returned original-source excerpts were read. Only URL provenance and original paraphrases retained. No article/recipe copies.
